method.method_draft: Use a coordinate model. From the image, note the configuration: A is above the base BC, D lies on segment BC between B and C, E is to the right, and AD, AE, DE are connected. From the text, use AB=AC=2√2 and ∠BAC=90°, so triangle ABC is an isosceles right triangle with hypotenuse BC=4. Place B=(0,0), C=(4,0). Then A is the midpoint-above point (2,2), and since BD=1, D=(1,0). Compute AD^2=(2-1)^2+(2-0)^2=5. From the text condition AD⊥AE and AD=AE, triangle ADE is right isosceles at A, so DE^2=AD^2+AE^2=2AD^2=10. Hence DE=√10.
